items.title: Lane Johnson's retirement could create a cap mess for the Eagles in 2027
items.body_text: Eagles right tackle Lane Johnson said in August that 2026 will probably be his last year.
items.author: Mike Florio

items.title: Through four weeks of the season, zero kickoff return touchdowns
items.body_text: The NFL may like to call kickoffs "Dynamic," but the most dynamic thing that can happen on a kickoff hasn't happened at all this season.
items.author: Michael David Smith

items.title: 49ers DE Mykel Williams: "Losing my mind" with excitement for return to lineup
items.body_text: 49ers defensive end Mykel Williams's long path back to the field after last season's torn ACL is close to the finish line.
items.author: Josh Alper

items.title: Sean Payton: Offensive focus needs to be on details, not who calls plays
items.body_text: When the Broncos changed offensive playcallers this offseason, it guaranteed a lot of attention would be paid to how the unit fared with offensive coordinator Davis Webb calling the shots instead of head coach Sean Payton.
items.author: Josh Alper

items.title: Cowboys will "move pieces around" in field goal protection after blocks two weeks in a row
items.body_text: Cowboys head coach Brian Schottenheimer says changes are being made after the Cowboys have had field goals blocked in their last two games.
items.author: Michael David Smith

items.title: Mike Macdonald on Joe Mixon: "Didn't work out"
items.body_text: The Seahawks, who are thin at running back, brought Joe Mixon to town for a workout on Monday.
items.author: Mike Florio

items.title: Odell Beckham Jr.'s arrival could be a message to Jauan Jennings
items.body_text: The Vikings didn't sign receiver Odell Beckham Jr. for P.R. purposes.
items.author: Mike Florio

items.title: 49ers WR Mike Evans limited in Wednesday's practice
items.body_text: 49ers wide receiver Mike Evans played through an injury to his ribs, catching five passes for 76 yards.
items.author: Charean Williams

items.title: Jesse Minter on Lamar Jackson: A lot of time between now and Sunday
items.body_text: Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson didn't practice on Wednesday because of the ankle injury that has left doubt about whether he'll play against the Falcons this Sunday, but head coach Jesse Minter isn't ruling him out at this point.
items.author: Josh Alper

items.title: Sean Payton: I "don't think" Patrick Surtain II, Pat Bryant will land on IR
items.body_text: Broncos cornerback Patrick Surtain II and cornerback Pat Bryant suffered ankle injuries during Sunday's loss to the 49ers.
items.author: Mike Florio

items.title: Zay Flowers limited, Trey Hendrickson out at Ravens practice
items.body_text: Reports from the open portion of Ravens practice were that wide receiver Zay Flowers was not on the field, but he wound up getting on the field later in the day.
items.author: Josh Alper

items.title: Brock Bowers limited in Wednesday's practice
items.body_text: Tight end Brock Bowers (knee) was limited in Wednesday's practice.
items.author: Charean Williams

items.title: Drake Maye is skeptical of the moon landing
items.body_text: Sunday's win at Buffalo was one small step for Maye, one giant leap for the Patriots.
items.author: Mike Florio

items.title: John Harbaugh: Giants are "just not good enough" at generating explosive runs
items.body_text: The longest run from a Giants running back this season was a 13-yarder by Cam Skattebo.
items.author: Michael David Smith

items.title: Saquon Barkley, DeVonta Smith did not practice Wednesday
items.body_text: Eagles running back Saquon Barkley did not practice Wednesday.
items.author: Charean Williams

items.title: Chargers RT Joe Alt did not practice Wednesday, not expected to play Sunday
items.body_text: Right tackle Joe Alt (neck) was one of eight Chargers who didn't practice on Wednesday.
items.author: Charean Williams

items.title: Odell Beckham Jr.: Kevin O'Connell wanted me to be here
items.body_text: Vikings coach Kevin O'Connell and new Vikings receiver Odell Beckham Jr. spent time together with the Rams, and they both have a Super Bowl ring from it.
items.author: Mike Florio

items.title: Falcons LT Jake Matthews, DE Za'Darius Smith did not practice Wednesday
items.body_text: Falcons left tackle Jake Matthews made his 199th consecutive start on Monday night, the longest active streak in the NFL.
items.author: Charean Williams

items.title: Justin Jefferson returns to practice, Jordan Addison sits out
items.body_text: The Vikings got Justin Jefferson back at practice on Wednesday, but another wideout was missing from the workout.
items.author: Josh Alper

items.title: Sam LaPorta: Don't know if extension is off the table, but there's a stalemate
items.body_text: A contract extension for Lions tight end Sam LaPorta may not be off the table, but it doesn't sound like the two sides are close to an agreement.
items.author: Josh Alper

items.title: Ravens expect Cam Jurgens to be ready to play in Week 6
items.body_text: The Ravens traded for center Cam Jurgens on Wednesday, but it doesn't look like his debut for the team will come for another week.
items.author: Josh Alper

items.title: Tyler Shough limited in practice with left hand injury
items.body_text: Saints quarterback Tyler Shough had his left hand hit in Monday night's loss to the Falcons but played all 74 snaps.
items.author: Charean Williams

items.title: Seahawks DT Jarran Reed: Players hit penalty issues "head on" in meeting this week
items.body_text: Seahawks head coach Mike Macdonald called the team's seven personal fouls in last Sunday's win over the Chargers "unacceptable at any level" and his players didn't wait to go to work on cleaning things up this week.
items.author: Josh Alper

items.title: Aaron Rodgers won't comment on whether play calls are coming in fast enough
items.body_text: After Thursday night's loss in Cleveland, Steelers quarterback Aaron Rodgers wasn't asked about his viral moment with coach Mike McCarthy, sparked by Rodgers's obvious frustration with the time it was taking to communicate the play call to the huddle.
items.author: Mike Florio

items.title: Breece Hall remains out of practice for the Jets
items.body_text: The Jets called running back Breece Hall week-to-week after he suffered a quad injury in their Week 3 loss to the Lions and Wednesday's practice report gave reason to believe his return to action won't come this week.
items.author: Josh Alper

items.title: Jalen Ramsey, Jamel Dean did not practice on Wednesday
items.body_text: The Steelers did not have a couple of defensive backs for Wednesday’s practice as they begin to get ready to face the Colts.
items.author: Myles Simmons

items.title: Patriots WR Mack Hollins hopes to practice later this week
items.body_text: Patriots wide receiver Mack Hollins did not practice on Wednesday, but he hopes to be back on the practice field later this week.
items.author: Charean Williams

items.title: Ja'Marr Chase, Tee Higgins among six Bengals out of practice
items.body_text: The Bengals had six players miss Wednesday's practice.
items.author: Charean Williams

items.title: In joint statement, NFL and NFLPA say drinking celebrations will be permitted
items.body_text: For "gray area" celebrations, NFL will communicate with player before fining him.
items.author: Mike Florio

items.title: Giants list Malik Nabers as out of practice
items.body_text: The first Giants practice of the week was missing a key member of the offense.
